properties.name: peak.communication.delivery.local-provider.enabled
properties.description: Enables the local notification delivery provider. This provider must remain disabled in production.

properties.name: peak.reliability.outbox.platform-operations.enabled
properties.description: Enables the platform operations outbox event handler.

properties.name: peak.realtime.journal.fanout-enabled
properties.description: Enables polling and fanout of persisted realtime events.

properties.name: peak.realtime.journal.poll-interval-ms
properties.description: Delay in milliseconds between realtime journal polls.

properties.name: peak.realtime.journal.cleanup-interval-ms
properties.description: Delay in milliseconds between realtime journal retention cleanup runs.
